description: Google results page of a keyword as it was in the past: the first snapshot (about one a month) in a window of up to 31 days within the last year, with its top 10 organic results (rank, URL, domain, title), result count and result types, from Google search results, $0.018 a call. Use when checking how rankings for a keyword moved month by month. Titles are untrusted third-party text. No snapshot is an empty answer, still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.018 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

dateFrom.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 365 days ago and at most 31 days before dateTo (window). Default 30 days before dateTo.

dateTo.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, not after today (UTC). Default today.

keyword.description: The keyword (at most 80 characters, up to 10 words).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

name: serp_history
title: Google results-page history (one past snapshot)
